purpose: Deterministic composition/palette/effects diversity router for candidate V2 object-first cards. Reuses the proven hashing pattern from src/diversityLayer.js (stable per-dimension hash of the canonical id, so the same id always routes to the same values across regenerations) but with a new, independent set of dimensions suited to object-first/non-human-led scenes rather than V1's human-presentation dimensions (gender/body/hair etc, which do not apply here). Round 3 validated that this kind of router is necessary and effective: 11/12 archetype-compliant results and a genuine break from the golden-hour/cozy/centered/sparkle sameness pattern.
scene_family_note: Added post-Validation-16 (starting commit 53f72d2). Real generated images showed visible convergence on one repeated rendered pattern - dark/blue-toned indoor scene + warm practical lamp + empty desk/table/workspace + cozy polished atmosphere - even though composition_archetype/palette_lighting_route distributions were statistically healthy. scene_family is an independent dimension controlling the overall experiential STRUCTURE of the image (not a synonym for composition or palette), specifically to stop that one scene type from being the default fallback. It is NOT a claim that rendered visual diversity is now proven - only that prompt-level scene-family diversity is deterministic and audited; see audit_summary_v2.json's rendered_diversity_disclaimer.

scene_family.description: The overall experiential scene structure - independent of and orthogonal to composition_archetype (camera/framing) and palette_lighting_route (color/time-of-day). Deterministically assigned per id, then adjusted by a sliding-window de-collision pass over catalog order so the same family does not repeat too densely in any local run of the catalog.

values.open_daylight_outdoor: An open outdoor space in clear daylight, un-enclosed by walls.
values.cool_night_outdoor: An outdoor space at night or dusk, cool-toned ambient/artificial light.
values.bright_clean_interior: A bright, high-key interior with even, unmoody lighting.
values.dark_cinematic_interior: A dark or dim interior with one strong, dramatic light source.
values.warm_intimate_interior: A warm-lit, cozy interior with a single practical light (lamp, spotlight).
values.industrial_workshop: A workshop/maker/craft space with visible tools, materials, and work-in-progress texture.
values.technical_lab: A clinical, technical, or laboratory-like environment - clean, precise, equipment-forward.
values.architectural_grand: A large-scale architectural space where the structure itself is a major visual element.
values.overhead_tabletop_scene: A scene viewed from directly above a table or flat surface, the surface itself forming the composition.
values.macro_material_scene: An extreme close-up scene where material texture and surface detail dominate over any wider environment.
values.nature_environmental: A scene dominated by natural terrain, plants, water, or weather rather than any built structure.
values.minimal_studio: A deliberately sparse, mostly-empty studio-like space with negative space as a compositional tool.
values.exhibition_display: A display/showcase/exhibition-like arrangement - shelving, cases, or curated presentation of objects.

composition_archetype.description: Camera angle, object scale, and framing treatment.

values.macro_hero: Extreme close-up on texture/material detail of the hero object.
values.low_angle_kinetic: Camera positioned low, looking dramatically upward at the hero in motion.
values.overhead_tabletop: Camera looking straight down from directly above.
values.architectural_wide: A wide shot that shows the scale and architecture of the whole environment.
values.dense_detail: An elevated three-quarter view packed with rich supporting detail around the hero.
values.strong_diagonal: A bold diagonal line (light, edge, or object arrangement) creates dynamic tension instead of a centered symmetrical shot.
values.action_aftermath_frame: A still, ground-level or eye-level frame centered on physical traces of a very recent action.
values.minimal_iconic: The hero occupies a small, precisely placed area within a large field of negative space.
values.quiet_atmospheric: A mostly dark or muted scene with a single isolated light source on the hero.
values.rainy_moody_window: An intimate interior view framed by a window with soft, diffused outdoor light.
values.elevated_three_quarter: A dynamic three-quarter medium-wide view, neither fully overhead nor fully eye-level.
values.extreme_scale_contrast: The hero object is shown dramatically larger or smaller relative to its surroundings than expected.

palette_lighting_route.description: Time of day and color-temperature family, deliberately spread across cool/warm/neutral rather than defaulting to warm/golden.

values.cool_night: Deep night blues, a single artificial light source (headlights, screen glow, neon), stars or dark sky.
values.bright_daylight: Crisp, clear, high-visibility daylight with saturated natural color.
values.rainy_moody: Soft grey rain-light, muted cool tones, one small warm accent light.
values.warm_intimate: A single warm light source (lamp, spotlight, oven glow) isolated against a cooler or dark surrounding.
values.neutral_overcast: Even, shadow-soft daylight with a restrained, muted palette.
values.dusk_transition: The in-between blue-to-orange light band just after sunset or before sunrise.
values.studio_dark: A controlled dark environment lit by one deliberate, focused light source.
values.cool_daylight_shade: Bright but cool-toned daylight, as in open shade or an overcast bright sky.

effect_level.description: Sparkle/glow/particle intensity. Weighted so most cards receive none or restrained treatment - sparkle/glow must never be the default.

semantic_guidance.none: No decorative particle effects of any kind.
semantic_guidance.restrained: A small, semantically-motivated effect only (steam for food, dust for a track/trail, water droplets for water sports, light glints on glass/metal) - never a magical sparkle unrelated to the hobby's real physics.
semantic_guidance.expressive: A stronger but still semantically-grounded effect (visible motion trail, glowing active process, dramatic light beam) reserved for hobbies whose defining moment is inherently dynamic or luminous (e.g. an active 3D print, a night road, an AI data structure).

unreasonable_examples: stars around every hobby regardless of semantics

anti_sameness_constraint: No catalog-wide distribution in this router should exceed roughly 15% concentration in any single composition_archetype or palette_lighting_route value (12 and 8 values respectively imply a uniform baseline of ~8.3% and ~12.5%); the audit must flag any value that exceeds double its uniform baseline as a suspicious concentration requiring review.
hashing_note: Implemented independently in src/objectFirstV2Router.js using the same FNV-1a stable-hash + modulo technique as src/diversityLayer.js's stableHash()/uniformPick()/weightedPick(), reimplemented locally rather than imported so V2 has zero code dependency on V1's diversity system and remains fully independently selectable.
